主要内容: In 2018, the retail sector continued to face significant challenges as the so-called 'retail apocalypse' persisted. This trend, which began in 2017, saw a steady decline in sales and an increase in store closures for traditional brick-and-mortar retailers. Following the closures of J.C. Penney and Macy’s in 2017, 2018 brought further disruptions with the shutdowns of Sears and Toys “R” Us. Additional retailers such as Mattress Firm, Bon-Ton, and Abercrombie & Fitch also faced similar fates. The ongoing impact of online shopping on physical retail spaces was a central factor in these closures, highlighting the shift in consumer behavior and the increasing dominance of e-commerce in the market.
